ShortDescription.Value: Every citizen gets a persistent personality, memory, relationships, moods, skills, and a life story you can follow. Friends drift apart, kids grow up, couples form and break, people get hurt, learn, grieve, and celebrate.

Publish.LongDescription:
Give your city a soul. Citizen Soul layers a full simulated inner life on top of every CS2 citizen — no two are the same, and none of them forget.
**What each citizen gets** * A generated personality (extroversion, conscientiousness) that biases how they live every day * Friendships, rivalries, romance, heartbreak, and family ties that evolve day by day * Moods that react to what happens to them — good days, bad days, grief, joy, stress * Skills (social, fitness, logic, craft) that grow from daily learning * Injuries and recovery, fights, therapy, bad habits, and fresh starts * Pets, hobbies, city quirks, coming-of-age rituals, and milestones from first school day to old age * A diary you can actually read — follow any citizen and watch their story unfold * City-wide life — holidays and seasons, nightlife, fandoms, fashion, food culture, faith, neighborhood character, gossip, reputation, and a city chronicle
**Player tools** * Follow panel — pick a citizen and watch their life in real time * Inspector — read mood, ties, skills, and recent events of anyone in the city * options.ini next to the mod dll — master switch plus 18 feature groups you can toggle * Localization — override any string with a lang/<culture>.json file * Perf reporting — one log summary every 5 minutes so big cities stay honest
**Compatibility** * Works with existing cities — citizens get souls on load * No save format changes beyond the mod's own component data; disabling the mod is safe * Built and tested for game version 1.1.*
Make your city feel human.

ChangeLog.Value: First public release — 151 features across 51 systems: personality, social life, romance and family, mind and mood, crime and justice, work, culture, media, rituals, companions, diary and panels. Includes the EP1 City Life expansion — mortality, strikes, gambling, organized crime, corruption, routines, food, faith, nightlife, fandoms, fashion, holidays, neighborhood character, gossip, reputation, mentorship, and the city chronicle — plus options.ini config, localization, and the 5-minute perf report.
